outcome.outcome: Long-horizon, heavily coordinated research that no current institutional form can house becomes fundable and organisable.
outcome.rationale: Their description names incentive structures that hinder certain kinds of outcomes, coordinated research specifically.

ai_types.rationale: All three capabilities are new funding and organisational structures; no technical capability moves this gap at all.

measurability.rationale: The quantity of interest is research that never happened because no institution could house it. There is no observation set for unproposed work, and proposals never written leave no record.

outcome.outcome: More evidence per patient and per dollar. The number of clinical questions answerable in a decade rises without a matching rise in cost.
outcome.rationale: Their description frames the loss as inefficiency in evidence gathering rather than as a shortage of trials.

ai_types.rationale: Adaptive design, arm allocation and enrichment are optimisation problems over an explicit information objective.
Digital twins and synthetic control arms are prediction problems, and both appear in their capability list.

measurability.rationale: Cost per trial, time to result, statistical power achieved and the share of trials ending inconclusive are all recorded in trial registries.

outcome.outcome: Getting a result into the permanent record gets cheap enough that publication stops selecting on how well-resourced your institution is.
outcome.rationale: Axis chosen is cost; their sentence bundles cost, speed and inclusiveness, and the other two are separate chains.

ai_types.rationale: Drafting and screening are already automatable; what binds is reviewer recruitment, judgment consistency and whether a hiring committee counts the output.
Drafting, screening and reviewer-matching assistance work today, which is precisely why they are not the binding link.

measurability.rationale: Article processing charges, total publishing spend, time from submission to publication and reviewer invitations per accepted review are all directly reported.

outcome.outcome: Fabricated work gets caught before other work is built on top of it.
outcome.rationale: Their description names trust and slowed progress as the two losses, and both come from undetected fraud propagating.

ai_types.rationale: Automated detection of image duplication, tortured phrases and statistical impossibility is deployed and finding real cases today.

measurability.rationale: Retractions and detected fraud are countable, but they measure detection capability rather than fraud prevalence. The denominator, undetected fraud, is by definition unobserved.

outcome.outcome: The literature can be queried as one body of knowledge rather than searched as a pile of documents, and what is already known stops being rediscovered.
outcome.rationale: Their description asks how AI-generated knowledge becomes cumulative, which is the unlock beyond mere retrieval.

ai_types.rationale: This is the canonical working case for language models, and all five of their capabilities are literature agents, synthesis infrastructure or knowledge models.

measurability.rationale: Synthesis quality on benchmark questions is measurable, but their actual target, whether machine-generated knowledge becomes cumulative, has no agreed observable.

notes: Metascience is the sharpest field for the thesis: the two gaps with a working-now LLM primary are the two whose measurability is only proxy or worse, and the gap with the pure institutional primary is the map's clearest counterfactual-required case. AI has arrived exactly where feedback is fastest and is absent where it is slowest.
